cinecreate.configuration.title: Cinematic Interactions: Create — Settings
cinecreate.configuration.scenes.tooltip: For each scene: start it with a right-click, only with the Work at the machine key, or never.
cinecreate.configuration.depot.tooltip:
A depot with no machine over it.
Right-click: every right-click on the plate starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own (puts down / takes at once); the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.pressing.toolti:
A depot with a Mechanical Press over it; clicking the press works too.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.valve_handle.to:
Any of the 17 Valve Handles.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene (with a dye in hand it stays Create's: recolouring).
Key only: a right-click is Create's own (turns it at once); the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.mechanical_craf:
A group of Mechanical Crafters, up to 10×10 (walls bigger than 3×3 need an Extendo Grip; a bigger group stays Create's).
Right-click: a right-click on a crafter's front starts the scene for its whole group.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own (puts in / takes at once); the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.hand_crank.tool:
The Hand Crank.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene; there, holding a mouse button turns it.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own (hold it to turn); the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.basin.tooltip:
A Basin, bare or with a mixer or a press above it (clicking the mixer or the press works too).
Right-click: a right-click into the basin starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.blaze_burner.to:
A Blaze Burner, fed through its cage (its top stays Create's: a basin goes there).
Right-click: a right-click on its cage starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own (feeds it at once); the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.spouting.toolti:
A depot with a Spout over it; clicking the spout works too.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.deploying.toolt:
A depot with a Deployer pointing down at it; clicking the deployer works too.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
A depot in the stream of an Encased Fan that washes, smokes, blasts or haunts.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.item_drain.tool:
The Item Drain, worked from its grate.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.deployer.toolti:
A Deployer, facing any way, at its hand: what you hold and what it holds change hands.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.millstone.toolt:
The Millstone, filled from above.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
A Mechanical Saw facing up, at its table; the shapes it can cut hang over the blade.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.weighted_ejecto:
The Weighted Ejector, at its plate.
Right-click: a right-click starts the scene.
Key only: a right-click is Create's own; the Work at the machine key (H) starts the scene.
Off: never a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.invitation.tool: The "[H] Work at the depot" plate under the crosshair at blocks whose scene starts on the key. The key works without it too.
cinecreate.configuration.clientMode.tool: On a server without this add-on, a right-click on these blocks is still Create's own. On: it is played out as a scene: the view settles on the block, the hand reaches out with the item in hand and Create's own click follows (1–9 or the wheel choose the item). Off: plain clicks. Taken when joining a server: a change applies from the next connection.
At a Weighted Ejector, the head turns to follow what it throws to where it lands, then back. Only for targets up to 32 blocks away.
